verdict.rationale: Environment isolation is a fair question for a deployment platform, so the axis applies. Netlify documents deploy previews and team-level management of access, secrets, and env vars, but nothing shows non-production deploys being scoped or network-restricted from production services. Team-scoped env vars and preview URLs are adjacent features, not the isolation capability itself.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can isolate non-production environments from accessing production services
